FORMS AND ENDORSEMENTS SCHEDULE
CG 00 01 04 13   Commercial general liability coverage form
CG40 47 01 26    Exclusion for generative artificial intelligence
CG 40  48        Coverage B only version
IL 00 17         Common policy conditions

COMMERCIAL GENERAL LIABILITY ENDORSEMENT (sample wording, own words)
This sample endorsement removes cover for bodily injury and property
damage that arises out of generative artificial
intelligence. In this sample, the term means a machine-
based learning system or model that can create content.

MANAGEMENT LIABILITY ENDORSEMENT (sample wording, own words)
We will not pay for any Claim based upon, arising out of, or
attributable to any actual or alleged use, deployment, or development
of Artificial Intelligence, or in any way involving a hiring tool.
The sample definition says any machine-based system that, for explicit or
implicit objectives, infers, from the input it receives, how to produce results.

CRIME POLICY SAMPLE
Social engineering fraud is covered up to a sublimit shown on the declarations.
Callback verification is required before a transfer.
